title: Winning at the Design AI and Tech Awards!
summary: Excited to take home an award at the Design AI and Tech Awards (Daita)!
description: Ailytics won in the Startups and SMEs category at the Design AI and Tech Awards (Daita), run by The Business Times and SUTD. Read the announcement.
html: We participated in the Design AI and Tech Awards (Daita) - a joint collaboration between The Business Times and Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD). Excited to take home an award in the "Startups and SMEs" category!
